overview: A premium single-event concert ticket website for ZAVY — LIVE IN BANDUNG, taking visitors from a cinematic hero through ticket selection, checkout, payment, and a luxury digital e-ticket.
features: Cinematic full-screen hero with a live countdown to the show
Event information, venue location card, and artist lineup
Three ticket tiers with real remaining stock and quantity selectors
Sticky buy-ticket bar that follows you while browsing
Simple checkout with order summary and service fee
Payment method selection with order number and deadline
Luxury e-ticket with a scannable QR code and download
